Kid-friendly fonts bundled for offline picture-book typesetting.
They are SIL Open Font License 1.1 (full text in the OFL-*.txt files).

- Nunito — Vernon Adams, Cyreal. Regular, bold, italic, bold italic (latin subset).
- Baloo 2 — Ek Type. Regular and bold (latin subset). This family has no italic file;
  the italic button uses the upright face in print export.
- Andika — SIL International. Regular, bold, italic, bold italic (latin subset).

The app loads these with @font-face from this folder and embeds the same files
in print PDFs and fixed-layout EPUBs. No network request is required.
